Ilya: Brain-meltdown check — what's one album / film / book you use to 'reset' between long debugging stretches? Prefer <1hr options (short TV, songs, short docs) :coffee:
Priya: For me it's the 'Tiny Desk Concerts' playlist. 20–30min, mellow, always calms the brain. :notes:
Sam: Short TV ep: 'Ted Lasso' S1E5 usually. 30min, hits the reset button.
Maya: Album rec: 'For Emma' (Bon Iver) — whole thing is basically a sandbox for the brain. Also, here's a weird gif that sums up my mood: https://giphy.com/gifs/coffee-debug-3oEjI6SIIHBdRxXI40
Leo: Book rec (super short): 'The Sense of an Ending' — novella vibes, ~150 pages, quick transport.
giphy-bot: :sparkles: (gif posted) https://giphy.com/gifs/coffee-debug-3oEjI6SIIHBdRxXI40
Sam: Also, a tactical trick — 10min guided breathing YouTube video. `mpv https://youtube.com/watch?v=xxxx` and headphones. instant timer.
Priya: poll? Type 1 for music, 2 for TV, 3 for book — quick tally.
Ilya: 1
Maya: 1
Leo: 3
Sam: 2
Priya: results: music 2, TV 1, book 1. Looks like music wins but very close. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
Ilya: Thanks y'all — adding a 'debug-reset' playlist to my queue.
